question_text:
You have the following data sources:
✑ Finance: On-premises Microsoft SQL Server database
✑ Sales: Azure Cosmos DB using the Core (SQL) API
✑ Logs: Azure Table storage
✑ HR: Azure SQL database
You need to ensure that you can search all the data by using the Azure Cognitive Search REST API.
What should you do?

answers.A: Migrate the data in HR to Azure Blob storage.
answers.B: Migrate the data in HR to the on-premises SQL server.
answers.C: Export the data in Finance to Azure Data Lake Storage.
answers.D: Ingest the data in Logs into Azure Sentinel.

discussion:
C is the answer.

https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/search/search-data-sources-gallery

- Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2

- Azure SQL Managed Instance
- SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines
- Azure Files (in preview)
- Azure MySQL (in preview)
- SharePoint in Microsoft 365 (in preview)
- Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB (in preview)
- Azure Cosmos DB for Apache Gremlin (in preview)
